annotations.text: Drag anywhere — the whole editor area becomes the drop target, framed in ember. The Sources panel also carries a persistent "Import files…" button, so the flow is discoverable without dragging.

One review step before anything is filed: each file shows its detected format, the id it will take, and an editable title. Nothing lands as a loose blob — every import is a first-class SRC document (REQ-031).

After import: the new source opens in the reader with an "original" frontmatter row linking the preserved file. New rows glow briefly in the Sources panel; a quiet toast confirms. From here it behaves like any hand-authored document.
